meta.source: Census American Community Survey 2020-2024 5-year estimates, table B25127 (tenure by year structure built by units in structure)

groups.older_small_mid_pre1980: Renter homes in buildings of 2 to 49 homes built before 1980
groups.small_mid_1980_1999: Renter homes in buildings of 2 to 49 homes built 1980 to 1999
groups.older_large_pre1980: Renter homes in buildings of 50 or more homes built before 1980
groups.mobile_other_renter: Renter homes in mobile homes, boats, RVs or vans, any year
groups.single_unit_pre1980: Renter homes in one-unit houses built before 1980

meta.moe_method: Sums use the square root of the sum of squared margins (Census approximation, 90% level).
meta.reliability_rule: reliable = coefficient of variation (MOE/1.645/estimate) of 30% or less; this file's rule, not a Census rule.
limits: Counts renter households by the age and size of the building they live in; it does not say what rent they pay or whether a home is restricted.
Census size bins are 5-19, 20-49 and 50 or more homes, and age bins end in 1979 and 1999, so they do not line up exactly with the HB24-1175 right of first offer (15 to 100 homes, over 30 years old).
Small towns often have margins larger than the count; use the reliable flag before comparing places.
